comment: The example outcome, “a defined share of citizens issued with a verifiable health record,” focuses on issuance rather than meaningful access, usability, coverage, continuity, or health benefit. It may incentivise output measurement without demonstrating value.

public.text: The example outcome, “a defined share of citizens issued with a verifiable health record,” focuses on issuance rather than meaningful access, usability, coverage, continuity, or health benefit. It may incentivise output measurement without demonstrating value.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace or supplement it with outcome measures such as the proportion of the eligible population able to access a usable record, the proportion of encounters supported by relevant longitudinal information, and measurable improvement in continuity of care.
